title: 「So _ Neither _ Nor + Auxiliary」表示「……也是／……也不」
titleZh: 「So _ Neither _ Nor + Auxiliary」表示「……也是／……也不」
titleEn: Using so, neither and nor with an auxiliary to express agreement

source.file: Sentence Structure 122 - 「So _ Neither _ Nor + Auxiliary」表示「……也是／……也不」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Affirmative clause, and so + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject

formulas.formula: Affirmative clause, and so + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject
Negative clause, and neither + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject
Negative clause, nor + auxiliary verb / modal verb / be + subject

example: I enjoy jazz, and so does my brother.
exampleZh: 我喜歡爵士樂，我哥哥也喜歡。

examples.en: I enjoy jazz, and so does my brother.
examples.zh: 我喜歡爵士樂，我哥哥也喜歡。

examples.en: I haven’t finished, and neither has she.
examples.zh: 我還未完成，她也未完成。

examples.en: I haven’t finished, nor has she.
examples.zh: 我還未完成，她也未完成。

rules.zh: So 用於肯定句；neither 和 nor 用於否定句
rules.en: Use so after an affirmative statement; use neither or nor after a negative statement.
examples: Ella likes the film, and so does Sam.
Ella does not like the film, and neither does Sam.
Ella does not like the film, nor does Sam.

rules.zh: 必須使用倒裝語序 在 so、neither 或 nor 後面，助動詞必須放在主語之前。 注意：So he does. 可以是正確句子，但它表示「他的確如此」，而不是「他也是」。這並非本課的目 標用法。
rules.en: Use inverted word order: after so, neither or nor, the auxiliary must come before the subject. So he does can be grammatical, but it means ‘he certainly does’, not ‘he does too’, and is not the target use in this lesson.

rules.zh: 按照第一句的時態選擇助動詞 第一個句子的動詞 使用的助動詞 例子 一般現在時動詞 do / does Mia runs, and so does Leo. 一般過去時動詞 did Mia ran, and so did Leo. 情態動詞 重複相同的情態動詞 Mia can swim, and so can Leo.
rules.en: Choose the auxiliary to match the verb and tense of the first statement: use do or does for a present-tense lexical verb, did for a past-tense lexical verb, the corresponding form of be or have where present, and the same modal after a modal verb.

rules.zh: 助動詞要配合新的主語 第一句使用 enjoy，但第二個主語是單數的 my brother，因此要使用 does。
rules.en: Make the auxiliary agree with the new subject. Although the first clause uses enjoy, the new singular subject my brother requires does.
examples: I enjoy jazz, and so does my brother.
They enjoy jazz, and so do we.

rules.zh: Neither 和 nor 後面不要再加否定詞 Neither 和 nor 本身已經帶有否定意思，因此不可再使用 doesn’t、isn’t、can’t 等否定形式。
rules.en: Do not add another negative word after neither or nor. They already carry negative meaning, so forms such as doesn’t, isn’t and can’t must not follow them in this pattern.
examples: I do not drive, and neither does Amy.

rules.zh: Neither 和 nor 在本句型中的分別 兩者都可以表示「另一方也不」。 ● and neither + auxiliary + subject 在日常表達中十分常見。 ● nor + auxiliary + subject 可以直接連接前面的否定句，語氣通常稍為正式。 兩句意思相同。
rules.en: Neither and nor have slightly different linking patterns in this construction, although both mean that another person or thing shares the negative situation. And neither + auxiliary + subject is very common in everyday expression; nor + auxiliary + subject can link directly to the preceding negative clause and usually sounds slightly more formal. The two versions have the same meaning.
examples: and neither + auxiliary + subject 在日常表達中十分常見。
nor + auxiliary + subject 可以直接連接前面的否定句，語氣通常稍為正式。

rules.zh: 與 Neither...nor... 句型的分別 這個句型連接兩個分句，表示第二個主語具有與第一個主語相同的情況。 第二部分使用： Neither...nor... 是成對連接詞，用來把兩個主語、受詞、動詞或其他平行成分放在同一句中，表示 「兩者都不」。 主要分別是： ● neither...nor... 把兩個項目組成一個完整結構。 ● neither / nor + auxiliary 先提出第一個情況，再表示另一個主語「也不」。 ● neither / nor + auxiliary 必須使用助動詞倒裝。 ● neither...nor... 不使用這種「助動詞＋主語」的附和倒裝結構。
rules.en: Do not confuse this agreement pattern with the correlative neither...nor structure. The target pattern links two clauses and says that the second subject shares the first subject’s situation, using neither or nor + auxiliary + subject. Correlative neither...nor joins two subjects, objects, verbs or other parallel elements into one structure meaning ‘neither one nor the other’. Thus neither...nor groups two items without agreement inversion, while neither or nor + auxiliary first states one situation, then says that another subject shares it, and requires auxiliary-subject inversion.
examples: neither...nor... 把兩個項目組成一個完整結構。
neither / nor + auxiliary 先提出第一個情況，再表示另一個主語「也不」。
neither / nor + auxiliary 必須使用助動詞倒裝。
neither...nor... 不使用這種「助動詞＋主語」的附和倒裝結構。
Amy cannot swim, and neither can Ben.
Neither Amy nor Ben can swim.
Neither the manager nor the employees were happy.

benefits.zh: 避免重複整個動作 使用這個句型後，不需要重複 enjoys jazz，使句子更簡潔。
benefits.en: It avoids repeating the whole action, such as enjoys jazz, and therefore makes the sentence more concise.

benefits.zh: 清楚表示兩者的情況相同 So 清楚表示另一方具有相同的肯定情況；neither 和 nor 則清楚表示另一方具有相同的否定情 況。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that two people or things share the same situation: so marks a shared affirmative situation, while neither and nor mark a shared negative one.
examples: The students were ready, and so was the teacher.
The students were not ready, and neither was the teacher.

benefits.zh: 讓對話聽起來更自然 這些結構是英語會話中常見的附和方式。 掌握這個句型後，你可以更自然地回應別人的經歷、喜好和意見。
benefits.en: It makes conversation sound more natural. These are common English ways of agreeing with another person’s experience, preference or opinion, so mastering them helps you respond more naturally.

benefits.zh: 幫助連接相關內容 這個句型能把兩個具有相同情況的人或事物連接起來，使文章更連貫，而不是寫成多個重複的短 句。
benefits.en: It helps connect related information by linking people or things that share a situation, producing a more coherent passage instead of several repetitive short sentences.

benefits.zh: 幫助掌握助動詞和時態 使用這個句型時，學生需要判斷應使用 do、does、did、is、were、has、can、will 等形式。因此，它 亦能加強學生對時態、主謂一致和情態動詞的掌握。
benefits.en: It reinforces auxiliaries and tense because students must choose among forms such as do, does, did, is, were, has, can and will, strengthening their control of tense, subject-verb agreement and modal verbs.
